patterns.note: The site uses a dark-themed, full-width section layout with content consistently centered and ample vertical spacing between major sections.
A dominant dark blue-black background (#101820) is contrasted with white text and accented with subtle purple-blue gradients and glows, particularly around interactive elements and product mockups.
Headings are large, bold, and sans-serif, providing clear hierarchy against smaller, lighter body text, often accompanied by small uppercase labels for context.

The main navigation bar transforms from transparent to a solid dark background and slightly shrinks as the user scrolls past the hero. Content sections fade in and slide up subtly as they enter the viewport, and a large, glowing outline of the 'affirm' logo gradually reveals itself in the background towards the bottom of the page.

Many content sections feature a prominent product mockup (e.g., phone app, credit card) on one side, balanced by explanatory text and calls to action on the other, often with a subtle glowing effect around the mockups.

technique_notes: A sticky header dynamically changes its background color and height upon scroll, providing a compact navigation experience after the initial hero section.

Content sections are revealed with a staggered fade-up and subtle slide-in animation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic and engaging scroll experience, likely managed by a scroll animation library like locomotive-scroll.

A large, stylized brand logo is integrated as a background element in the footer, animating its glow and outline as the user scrolls towards the end of the page, possibly using canvas or SVG animation for a distinctive visual anchor.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) with clear hierarchy, complemented by smaller, lighter body text and occasional uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Rounded; a consistent large radius is applied to cards, buttons, input fields, and product mockups, contributing to a soft and approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy; generous vertical spacing between full-width sections, with content within sections maintaining comfortable padding and margins.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a dark theme with subtle, glowing purple-blue accents, combined with consistently rounded corners across all UI elements and the unique, large animated background logo at the page's end, creates a sophisticated yet approachable and modern aesthetic that feels premium and trustworthy.
